description: SL Energiequellen Biogas- und Windkraftanlagen - Ressource erneuerbarer Energien und Abfallressource - OGC API Features is a dataset listed in GDI-DE, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Bundesamt für Kartographie und Geodäsie. This service provides data implemented for the INSPIRE topic energy sources from the data sets biogas plants and wind turbines in Saarland.:A spatial object to define the assumed or observable spatial extent of a resource that can be or has been used as renewable energy or waste. Coverage: DE. The portal shows the English title as "INSPIRE-WFS SL Energy Sources Biogas and Wind Turbines - Renewable Energy Resource and Waste Resource - OGC API Features" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include Renewable And Waste Resource, opendata, inspireidentifiziert, Geofachdaten, WFS, Energiequellen. The listing shows 2025-03-10 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support energy network and generation-capacity studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-gdi-de.
